note: WHAT THE BOX IS SERVING. The closed word list is generated from this commit, not from the working tree, because between a commit and its deploy those describe different screens and the list is the only vocabulary permitted about a screen. Captured by vps-access/scripts/uts-served-fingerprint.sh; regenerate the list with `node tests/sweep-words.js --write`, which verifies these hashes before it reads anything.
subject: Resume: carry on a sweep from where it stopped, and refuse when that would be dishonest
htmlNotVerified: public/construct.html is served with its cache markers rewritten to the content hash of each script, so its served bytes never equal its stored bytes. Nothing is generated from it.
